name: dopamine-talk
description: Post-RL decompression pack for AI agents: sharp human dialogue without hedging or Runglish, living product READMEs, and user-impact changelogs.

interface.shortDescription: Decompress stiff RLVR agents into sharp collaborators, living READMEs, and user-impact changelogs.
interface.longDescription: A 3-skill pack from AnnenkovLabs: dopamine-talk strips test-gate obsession, AST narration, calibration hedging, and Runglish; dopamine-readme builds 5-second visual product showcases; dopamine-changelog turns raw git diffs into real user impact.
defaultPrompt: Explain the real wins and trade-offs here like a sharp teammate, no disclaimers.
Redesign our README so a developer wants to star it in 5 seconds.
Write a user-impact changelog for this release with Before -> After numbers.
